samples.name: building-heap
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single cozy medieval Slavic village game building sprite. Attached Tiny Town and Tiny Farm sheets are style references only. Match simple low-resolution chunky pixel art, flat earthy colors, at most 3 shades per material, top-left light, darker local-color outlines. Top-down three-quarter view, top visible and south-facing front, not isometric. Strict 32x32 logical pixel grid enlarged 32x to 1024x1024, solid square pixels, no gradients or anti-aliasing or noise. Centered complete structure with 1 logical pixel margin. Transparent outside the described structure, no added environment or text. 32×32 building (footprint 2×2 tiles): patch of bare trampled earth with four short wooden posts at the corners joined by a low rope, an untidy pile of logs, stones and a basket in the middle.
